profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer / Manager of Product Developmet
profile.summary:
Self-directed software engineering professional with more than 15 years of progressive experience in software development and engineering with a proven track record for project delivery on time and under budget within numerous Fortune 500 companies.  Combine strong analytical, troubleshooting and business acumen with solid leadership, strategic and team building skills to consistently deliver successful products and solutions. Results-driven, organized, motivated, customer-focused, pro-active, innovative, strategic leader with a deep knowledge of software development best practices and standards while utilizing exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

Technical Expertise:
Java 1.6, J2EE, Spring MVC, Spring Beans, Spring Web Services, WebLogic Web Servers, WebLogic Application Servers, Single Sign On, Eclipse Helios, SDLC Methodologies – Waterfall & Agile, Subversion, Log4j, JUnit, EZ Mock, TIBCO ESB, Camel, JMS, XML Beans, Axis 2, ANT, SOAP, OFX, WSDL, EJB, JSP, IDL, JDBC, Linux/Unix, Windows, Solaris, Netscape Enterprise Server 4.0, Oracle 10g DB, Oracle WebLogic 11g R1, BEA WebLogic 9.2, Apache Web Server 2.0, Test Track Pro , Visual Paradigm, Version One, SQL Developer, Cygwin, Security Certificates, Trust Stores & Key Stores, HTTP Client, Hibernate, Crucible, ClearCase, OS370/390 Assembly, SymConnect/Symitar, CSAPI, CORBA, Swing, JNI, Servlets, Applets, SQL, C, C++

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Serve as point of contact for internal Project Managers, Development Managers and Client Developers.
•	Manage direct relationship with client’s development team while managing the implementation of mobile banking solutions for top financial institutions, mobile carriers and partners.
•	Responsible for launching five of the top ten financial institutions implementing mobile banking and SMS who account for 70% of the company’s subscriber base – clients including Chase, Citibank, US Bank, Regions and USAA.
•	Write, review and deploy code across all environments while ensuring all code is fulfilling Firethorn coding standards; assist less seasoned Developers if issues are encountered.
•	Facilitate and manage new client interfaces, integration and network connectivity with clients for all environments through the project lifecycle for while counseling client Developers on the Firethorn system functionality.
•	Executed the first SMS implementation for Firethorn as well as the relationship with mBlox to get short codes certified with all carriers.
•	Communicate and lead development path for my scrum team based on company goals and collaboration with technical colleagues.
•	Provide assistance to clients in the QA process for all applications for UAT (User Acceptance Testing), which allows for expansion of knowledge for all products.
•	Assist QA with understanding and testing new features and triaging bugs/issues if encountered during the process.
•	Consistently meet with Product Management to ensure accurate understanding of all product features and functionality to be communicated to the rest of the team.
•	Perform server tests with JUnit to assist in re-factoring and testing code.
•	Designated as new hire mentor, which includes introduction to environment setup, company intranet, Agile SDLC acclimation and introductions to team members and areas of expertise.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed Struts based XML generator for web based video learning classes.
•	Team Lead for eLearning infrastructure and production support.
•	Created UI and logic for an XML wizard in Java and JSPs using Struts on a Web Sphere platform.
•	Maintained and enhanced java based delivery and management system for web based learning content for the Home Depot enterprise.
•	Developed Next Generation Graphical Order Creation service for Home Depot EXPO stores.  One of two in charge of business logic development, and enhancements for Special Services order service using Java2, J2EE, JDBC, RMI, Informix and DB2.
•	Developed Graphical Work List order expediting application business logic for Home Depot call centers in Tampa, Dallas, Chicago, and San Diego using J2EE and Java2.
•	Enhanced and maintained Central Fax application -- which allows inbound faxes from vendors to the Home Depot from around the country to be received, stored, and displayed to the appropriate call center for order processing depending on geographic location -- for Home Depot call centers using J2EE, Java2 and Swing.  Supported business logic and UI, including an interface to SIEBEL.
•	Project Lead responsible for the I.T. setup of new stores opening under the service of any of the Home Depot call centers across the U.S.
•	Graphical order creation service business logic and UI work in Java for EXPO Design Centers.
•	Managed a group of contractors to meet deadlines.
•	Project lead for new call center store openings.
•	Performed server tests with JUnit to assist in re-factoring and testing code.
•	Graphical work list 1.0 business logic development in Java for EXPO Design Centers and call centers.
•	Central fax application enhancements and support of business logic and UI maintenance in Java for call centers.
•	Mentor for new hires.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Created an employee portal using Enterprise Java Beans (EJB), WebLogic, JSP’s, Struts, and BroadVision 6.0
•	Performed server tests with JUnit to assist in re-factoring and testing code.
•	Front-end framework using Struts.
•	Designed and implemented Pay-Per-View Streaming Video System using Sockets, and JDBC.
•	Back-end development using EJBs and WebLogic Application Servers.

positions.title: Software Engineer / Server Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed, upgraded and maintained Java servers.
•	Implemented and utilized a CORBA monitoring system for Java field server running on VA Linux boxes, using IDL, Swing and JDBC.
•	Designed and implemented automatic media downloads using Servlets, Sockets, JNI, and C.
•	Assisted network operations with problems in field servers.

positions.title: System Programmer / Communications Middleware Analyst
positions.description:
•	Implemented a Java/CORBA monitoring for Transaction Processing Facility (TPF).
•	Executed multiple TPF projects solo and while collaborating with other teams.
•	Designed, coded and released a CORBA monitoring system for response times and message rates on TPF running on an IBM mainframe using Swing, JDBC, IDL, and Applets.
•	Developed Dynamic Communications Load on TPF almost exclusively in C.
•	Used Log4j for Server logging to help Network Operations.
•	Performed maintenance for communication applications on TPF.
•	Appointed as mentor for new hires.
